page.layout: Running head at top right; page number at top left. One page of text: a centred heading "COLLECTIO ARMORUM." above a brace diagram that runs down the page and is set in the middle-left. The diagram's boxes are read top to bottom. Catchword at bottom right. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: Hastula, trium pedum longitudine, digitali crassitie, ferro molli duodecim digitorum.
Scutum, latum duos pedes & semis, longum quattuor, & interdum palmum.
Gladius Hispaniensis, firmus mucrone & utrimque ictu.
Pila duo. Unum maius idque Minus, simile Venatorium[?] hastili. | Rotundum vel Quadrangulum.
Omnium istorum longitudo in ligno, tres cubiti; in ferro, totidem. Sed pars media fibulis nexa ligno. Mucro hamatus. Triarij ferunt hastas.
Lorica duplex, vel è lamina aerea seu ferrea, digitorum undique duodecim, Pectorale dicta:
Vel ex catenis & squamulis confecta, qua[?] Hamata. Hac ditiorum.

page.notes: The diagram's brace lines and the stray mark at the centre-left of the box column are not printed text and are not transcribed. Faint text at the top and in the lower left is show-through from the reverse side and is left out; a faint mark near the foot at left is likely show-through too. "aerea" in the Galea line is uncertain (could be "area"). "è" in the Lorica line and "qua" in the last Lorica line are uncertain. "Venatorium" is uncertain. The printed heading and labels use capital V for u; these are changed to U.
